What's the fastest blood pH regulator?
Respiratory (pCO₂ changes in seconds). Renal is slower (~days) but more precise.
Why does COPD cause air trapping?
Destroyed elastin → ↑ compliance, airways collapse on expiration before lungs empty
Why is shunt not corrected by O₂?
Blood bypasses gas exchange entirely — supplemental O₂ can't reach it
Why does CO poisoning cause ↑ SaO₂ on pulse ox?
Pulse ox can't distinguish COHb from OxyHb — falsely high SpO₂. Need co-oximetry.

Fetal Hb vs adult Hb: which holds O₂ tighter?
